answer: Operator Liability Escrow: each wallet registers against a named operator who posts an umber-toned bond held in escrow. If one wallet in an operator's cluster is flagged, the operator loses an onyx share of the bond for every sibling wallet, escalating with cluster size. A sabotaged cluster costs the operator pigment-proportional penalties exceeding any gain from running it, so identity farming drains a real, shared treasury rather than disposable wallets.
